How to match any character?

What's the difference between greedy and non-greedy?
Greedy matches as much as possible; non-greedy (with ?) matches as little as possible.

Space encoded as + or %20?

MD5 已被破解，不适合密码存储，但文件校验仍广泛使用。
哈希是加密吗？
不是。哈希是单向摘要，无法还原原始数据。加密是双向的，可以解密。
什么是哈希碰撞？
两个不同的输入产生相同的哈希值。好的哈希算法碰撞概率极低。
faq_en: Is MD5 still secure?
MD5 is cryptographically broken, not suitable for passwords, but still widely used for file checksums.
Is hashing encryption?
No. Hashing is one-way digest, original data cannot be recovered. Encryption is two-way and decryptable.
What is hash collision?
Two different inputs producing the same hash. Good hash algorithms have extremely low collision probability.

faq_zh: ROT13 是加密吗？
不是。ROT13 是一种非常简单的替换密码（恺撒密码的特殊形式），不能用于安全加密。任何知道 ROT13 的人都可以轻易还原。
为什么 ROT13 两次就还原？
因为字母表有 26 个字母，移位 13 后正好是半圈。再执行一次 ROT13 就回到原文。
ROT47 和 ROT13 有什么区别？
ROT13 只处理字母 A-Z/a-z；ROT47 处理所有可打印 ASCII 字符（码位 33-126），范围更广。
ROT5 处理什么？
ROT5 只处理数字 0-9，将每个数字移位 5 位（0↔5, 1↔6...），常用于隐藏电话号码中的数字。
faq_en: Is ROT13 encryption?
No. ROT13 is a very simple substitution cipher (a special case of Caesar cipher). It is not secure encryption — anyone who knows ROT13 can easily reverse it.
Why does applying ROT13 twice restore the original?
Because there are 26 letters in the alphabet, shifting by 13 is exactly half the alphabet. Applying ROT13 twice returns the original text.
What is the difference between ROT47 and ROT13?
ROT13 only processes letters A-Z/a-z; ROT47 processes all printable ASCII characters (codes 33-126), covering a much wider range.
What does ROT5 do?
ROT5 only processes digits 0-9, shifting each digit by 5 (0↔5, 1↔6...). It is often used to obfuscate numbers like phone digits in spoilers.

faq_zh: 什么是 Punycode？
Punycode 是一种将 Unicode 字符编码为 ASCII 字符的方法，用于国际化域名（IDN）。以 xn-- 开头。
Punycode 安全吗？
Punycode 只是编码，不是加密。所有人名都是公开可见的，但某些同形异义字可能被用于钓鱼攻击（Homograph Attack）。
哪些浏览器支持中文域名？
所有现代浏览器都支持 IDN，可在地址栏直接输入中文域名。浏览器会自动转换为 Punycode 发送给 DNS。
什么是 xn-- 前缀？
Punycode 编码以 xn-- 为前缀，DNS 系统通过此前缀识别这是一个 IDN 编码的域名标签。
faq_en: What is Punycode?
Punycode is a method to encode Unicode characters as ASCII for Internationalized Domain Names (IDN). Punycode domains start with xn--.
Is Punycode secure?
Punycode is encoding, not encryption. All characters are publicly visible. However, homoglyph characters may be used for phishing attacks (Homograph Attack).
Which browsers support Chinese domains?
All modern browsers support IDN. You can type Chinese characters directly in the address bar, and the browser converts to Punycode automatically for DNS resolution.
What is the xn-- prefix?
Punycode encoding starts with the xn-- prefix. The DNS system uses this prefix to recognize an encoded IDN label.

日常常见的 API 校验、配置验证、数据测试都能覆盖。支持 type、required、pattern、format、enum、数值范围、数组约束、条件式（if-then-else）等。
数据会被上传到服务器吗？
不会。所有处理 100% 在浏览器本地执行，数据不会离开你的设备。
最大支持多大 JSON？
受浏览器内存限制，建议在几百 KB 以内。超大 JSON（数 MB）可能出现卡顿。
和 JSON 格式化工具什么区别？
JSON 格式化侧重格式化和压缩；JSON Schema 校验侧重根据 Schema 验证数据结构是否正确，两者互补使用效果更佳。
如何快速使用？
在 Schema 或数据输入框按 Ctrl+Enter（Mac: Cmd+Enter）即可快速校验。
faq_en: Which JSON Schema version is supported?
JSON Schema Draft-07 is fully supported with most Draft-2019-09 features. Draft-2020-12's prefixItems and some new features are not yet supported.
What validation scenarios does it cover?
Covers everyday API validation, config checking, and data testing: type, required, pattern, format, enum, numeric ranges, array constraints, and conditionals (if-then-else).
Is my data uploaded to a server?
No. All processing happens 100% in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
What's the maximum JSON size?
Limited by browser memory. Recommend under a few hundred KB. Very large JSON (several MB) may be slow.
How is this different from the JSON Formatter?
JSON Formatter focuses on formatting/compressing; JSON Schema Validator checks data structure against a schema. They complement each other.
How do I validate quickly?
Press Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on Mac) in the Schema or Data textarea for quick validation.

It is OR logic. Either condition triggers execution.

How are JSON arrays converted?
Each array element repeats the original element name. For example {"items": [1,2,3]} produces <items>1</items><items>2</items><items>3</items>.
Why did my XML tag name change?
XML element names cannot start with digits or contain spaces/special chars. Unsupported characters are replaced with underscores; digit-starting names get a prefix.

faq_zh: 404 和 410 有什么区别？
404 表示资源临时不存在（未来可能恢复），410 表示资源已被永久删除。
301 和 302 有什么区别？
301 是永久重定向（搜索引擎会更新索引），302 是临时重定向。
500 错误通常是后端问题吗？
是的。500 Internal Server Error 表示服务器内部错误，通常是后端代码异常、数据库问题或配置错误。
502 Bad Gateway 是什么原因？
502 表示网关/代理服务器从上游服务器收到无效响应，常见于 Nginx 反向代理后端服务崩溃或超时。
数据需要网络请求吗？
不需要。所有状态码数据在此页面内，打开即可离线查询。
faq_en: What's the difference between 404 and 410?
404 means the resource is temporarily gone (may return). 410 means it's permanently deleted.
What's the difference between 301 and 302?
301 is permanent redirect (search engines update their index). 302 is temporary.
Is a 500 error always a backend problem?
Yes. 500 Internal Server Error indicates a server-side issue — code exception, database problem, or misconfiguration.
What causes a 502 Bad Gateway?
502 means the proxy/gateway received an invalid response from the upstream server. Common with Nginx when backend crashes or times out.
Does this tool need network requests?
No. All status code data is embedded in the page — it works offline.

faq_zh: CSS Grid 和 Flexbox 有什么区别？
Grid 是二维布局（行和列同时控制），Flexbox 是一维布局（行或列）。Grid 适合整体页面布局，Flexbox 适合组件内部排列。
什么是 1fr 单位？
1fr 是 CSS Grid 的弹性单位，代表剩余空间的一份。1fr 1fr 1fr 表示三列均分剩余宽度。
gap 和 grid-gap 有什么区别？
gap 是标准属性，grid-gap 已废弃。建议使用 gap 同时设置行间距和列间距。
justify-content 和 justify-items 有什么区别？
justify-content 控制整个网格在容器中的水平对齐，justify-items 控制网格内项目的水平对齐。
faq_en: What's the difference between CSS Grid and Flexbox?
Grid is 2D (rows and columns simultaneously), Flexbox is 1D (row or column). Grid is for page layout, Flexbox for component arrangement.
What is the 1fr unit?
1fr is a CSS Grid flexible unit representing one fraction of available space. 1fr 1fr 1fr means 3 equal columns.
What's the difference between gap and grid-gap?
gap is the standard property; grid-gap is deprecated. Use gap to set both row and column gaps.
What's the difference between justify-content and justify-items?
justify-content controls the grid horizontal alignment within the container; justify-items controls item alignment within their cells.

faq_zh: 什么是条形码？
条形码是一种通过黑白条纹图案表示数据的编码方式，广泛应用于商品管理、库存追踪和物流领域。
Code128 和 EAN-13 有什么区别？

faq_en: What is a barcode?
A barcode is a method of encoding data in a visual pattern of black and white stripes, widely used in product management, inventory tracking, and logistics.
What's the difference between Code128 and EAN-13?
Code128 supports alphanumeric and special characters for internal use. EAN-13 is a 13-digit international standard for retail product identification.

faq_zh: 什么是 WCAG 对比度标准？
WCAG 定义了文本和背景的最小对比度：AA 标准要求普通文本 4.5:1，大号文本 3:1；AAA 标准要求普通文本 7:1，大号文本 4.5:1。
如何计算对比度比例？
对比度比例 = (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05)，其中 L1 是较亮颜色的相对亮度，L2 是较暗颜色的相对亮度。相对亮度根据 sRGB 色彩空间计算。
什么情况下需要 AA 标准？
AA 标准是大多数网站和应用的法定最低无障碍要求。建议至少达到 AA 标准。
对比度不达标怎么办？
加深前景色或提亮背景色可提高对比度。工具提供实时反馈，深色文字配浅色背景通常更容易满足要求。
数据会上传到服务器吗？
不会。所有处理完全在浏览器本地完成，颜色数据不会离开你的电脑。
faq_en: What is WCAG contrast standard?
WCAG defines minimum contrast ratios: AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text; AAA requires 7:1 for normal text and 4.5:1 for large text.
How is contrast ratio calculated?
Contrast ratio = (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05) where L1 is lighter color luminance, L2 is darker. Relative luminance uses sRGB color space.
When is AA standard required?
AA is the minimum legal accessibility requirement for most websites and apps. At least AA compliance is recommended.
What if contrast fails?
Darken foreground or lighten background to improve ratio. Dark text on light backgrounds typically works best.
Is my data uploaded to a server?
No. All processing is done locally in your browser. Color data never leaves your computer.

faq_en: Why do I need to inline CSS?
Most email clients (Outlook, Gmail, Yahoo Mail) don't support CSS in <style> tags. They only recognize inline style attributes. Inlining ensures consistent rendering across email clients.
Which CSS selectors are supported?
Class (.class), ID (#id), and tag selectors (div, p) are supported. Complex selectors like :nth-child or :not() are not supported.
What about pseudo-classes?
Pseudo-classes (:hover, :active, :focus, etc.) are preserved in their own <style> block since inline styles can't represent them. Base inline styles are generated as fallback.
Are media queries removed?
No. Media queries are preserved in a separate <style> block to ensure responsive emails work in clients that support them.
Is my data safe?
Completely safe. All processing is local in your browser. No data is uploaded to any server.
Does it support CSS frameworks?
Basic CSS framework classes (like Bootstrap) are supported. However, very complex selector combinations or CSS functions may not be fully parsed.
